evidence_requirement: Two signals: (1) UNKNOWN rate computed over the whole candidate set; (2) an invented role name maps to UNKNOWN rather than to its nearest neighbour (no silent snapping).
question_or_target: Target: extract participant roles and map them onto one normalized vocabulary so 'critic', 'red team' and 'refuter' are comparable. Acceptance: the mapping is a declared table, unmapped roles surface as UNKNOWN (never force-fitted), and the UNKNOWN rate is reported as a number.
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot - after the second failure on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b); a win-arg-limit failure retries once with --ignore-user-config and a prompt file, never inline argv
reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context
tests_required: invented role maps to UNKNOWN (both-states: a known synonym maps correctly)
UNKNOWN rate reported as a computed number
title: Implement role extraction with a normalized role vocabulary
